claims.text: PasswordHasher.Hash generates a 16-byte random salt via RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes, then Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2 with 100_000 iterations, SHA256, and a 32-byte output; returns "{iterations}.{salt base64}.{hash base64}".

PasswordHasher.Verify splits the stored string on '.', parses iterations/salt/hash, recomputes Pbkdf2 with the same salt and iteration count, and compares the result to the stored hash via CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals.
AuthController.Login is the only call site of PasswordHasher.Verify in this app's code; PasswordHasher.Hash has no call site at all - no registration endpoint exists yet.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-1: DonHang.Api/Controllers/AuthController.cs:17 (grep for PasswordHasher. across *.cs finds only this call and the class itself)

claims.text: Migration AddPasswordHashToCustomers adds a nullable text column password_hash to customers, then backfills one literal hash string for customer ids 1-5 via a raw SQL UPDATE, not five separate Hash calls.

RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes fills the array with a cryptographically strong random sequence of values, so each call returns an unpredictable 16-byte salt; two salts colliding is not something any real run will produce.

CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals compares two byte spans in an amount of time that depends on the length of the sequences, not on where or whether they first differ; a plain byte-by-byte comparison may stop at the first differing byte, the timing information FixedTimeEquals avoids leaking.

Nothing computes the password back from PBKDF2's stored output; the only route back is guessing a password and hashing it again to check for a match, which a higher iteration count makes slower, per Iterations (CA5387).
PBKDF2 cost grows with the iteration count; a higher count makes one hash computation proportionally slower, which is what slows down guessing.
claims.source_hint: refs/dotnet-docs code-analysis/quality-rules/ca5387.md; measured locally: Pbkdf2/SHA256/32B at 10k/100k/1M iterations on dotnet 10.0.300
